aiVerification.summary: Draft conflates E2/C2 SPK comparison with VP mold data and misidentifies the changed factor.
issues: Primary changed factor should be E2 vs C2 for main report, not VP mold lots.
Two sheets appear to contain different comparison contexts and are merged incorrectly.
Baseline/test condition includes date, headers, and sample numbers as conditions.
Many caliper measurement rows are parsed as numeric sequences, not valid outcomes.
Judgements and domains are not supported by the cited grouping.
correctionPlan: Rebuild main case around E2 vs C2 height dimension SPK comparison.
Separate or exclude VP mold sheet unless source context proves it belongs to the same validation.
Keep Go/No jig and caliper results as outcomes under E2 vs C2.
Remove header/date/number rows from changed conditions and subgroup keys.
Reparse caliper table using row and column headers before calculating summaries.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient and partly misapplied.
